name: AnymeX+ β (Beta)
subtitle: AnymeX+ beta builds
description: Beta builds of AnymeX+ (AnymeX with Stremio built in). Installs next to the normal app as AnymeX+ β, with its own sign-ins and library. New fixes land here first.

apps.name: AnymeX+ β
apps.subtitle: AnymeX+ beta builds
apps.localizedDescription: Beta builds of AnymeX+ (AnymeX with Stremio built in). Installs next to the normal app as AnymeX+ β, with its own sign-ins and library. New fixes land here first.
apps.versionDescription:
Beta v1.1.1-beta+6

- Beta 6: Movies & TV in Continue Watching, Missed sequels, Stremio entry picker, Discord and Windows sign-in fixes
  - One Continue Watching row on Home: your AniList anime and Movies & TV together, newest first; anime that sync to Stremio show once
  - Missed sequels row on Home: sequels of anime you completed that aren't on your AniList list (AnymeX Desk #151)
  - Anime Watch tab shows which Stremio entry progress goes to (IMDb or Kitsu) with a Change button; your pick is kept
  - Discord: the status is put back after a reconnect instead of "Browsing"; Movies & TV pages show "Viewing <title>" and link to IMDb/Kitsu (AnymeX Desk #137)
  - Windows: sign-in browser data lives in your user folder, so sign-in windows open when the app is installed for all users (AnymeX Desk #84)
